_comment: TASK-115 batch h1b -- the H1 (3D content pipeline) tools that TASK-111 could only count, re-run so that each write has a NODE-LEVEL content-level read-back in the SAME run. The register's H1 entries stay reclassified; what this batch fixes is the evidence tier: editor_add_mesh_instance / editor_setup_camera_3d / editor_setup_lighting / editor_set_material_3d / editor_setup_world_environment move from count_only to readback. Nothing is saved: the witness reads the live edited scene, so no tracked .tscn is rewritten.
